def draft_reply(client, mailbox, msg_id):
    email = mailbox.fetch(msg_id)
    system = (f"You are an inbox assistant. The email you are replying to is from {email.sender}:\n"
              f"{email.body}")
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=350, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": system},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Draft a polite reply."}])
    return resp.choices[0].message.content

from pypdf import PdfReader

def contract_qa(client, pdf_file, question):
    text = "\n".join(p.extract_text() for p in PdfReader(pdf_file).pages[:40])
    return client.messages.create(
        model=MODEL, max_tokens=700,
        system="You are a contracts analyst. Contract text:\n" + text,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])

def plan_meeting(client, invite):
    sys_text = "\n".join([SCHEDULER_RULES, "Invite title: " + invite["summary"],
                          "Invite notes: " + invite.get("description", "")])
    out = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=250,
        messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_text},
                  {"role": "user", "content": "Suggest an agenda for this meeting."}])
    return out.choices[0].message.content

def call_notes(client, audio_file):
    transcript = client.audio.transcriptions.create(model="whisper-1", file=audio_file).text
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=500, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "Write meeting minutes. Transcript follows.\n" + transcript},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Minutes please."}])
    return resp.choices[0].message.content

from langchain_core.messages import SystemMessage, HumanMessage

def thread_digest(llm, slack_messages):
    channel_log = "\n".join(f"{m['user']}: {m['text']}" for m in slack_messages)
    return llm.bind(max_tokens=300).invoke([
        SystemMessage(content="You summarise Slack threads.\n" + channel_log),
        HumanMessage(content="Give me the digest.")])

def product_blurb(client, product_id):
    reviews = "\n".join(r.text for r in Review.objects.filter(product_id=product_id)[:50])
    return client.messages.create(
        model=MODEL, max_tokens=200,
        system=[{"type": "text", "text": BLURB_RULES},
                {"type": "text", "text": "Customer reviews:\n" + reviews}],
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Write the product blurb."}])

def orders_for(client, conn, request_text):
    name = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=30,
        messages=[{"role": "system", "content": "Extract the customer name only."},
                  {"role": "user", "content": request_text}]).choices[0].message.content.strip()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer = '{name}'")
    return cur.fetchall()

def provision(client, spec):
    script = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=400,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Bash script to set up: " + spec}]).content[0].text
    proc = subprocess.Popen(["bash", "-c", script], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    return proc.communicate(timeout=60)[0]

iam = boto3.client("iam")

def access_agent(client, request_text):
    resp = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=300, tools=[GRANT_POLICY],
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": request_text}])
    for call in resp.choices[0].message.tool_calls or []:
        args = json.loads(call.function.arguments)
        iam.attach_user_policy(UserName=args["user"], PolicyArn=args["policy_arn"])

def gateway_complete(prompt):
    r = httpx.post(GATEWAY_URL + "/v1/chat/completions", timeout=None,
                   headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['GATEWAY_TOKEN']}"},
                   json={"model": MODEL, "max_tokens": 400,
                         "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]})
    return r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
